title: These are cute and keep wine cool
text: These are cute and keep wine cool. These stainless glasses are great. They are unbreakable and not made of plastic, which I LOVE!  I think a top is a must have for these.  It would keep the wine cooler and keep bugs, while enjoying the great outdoors.

product_metadata.title: Snowfox Elegance Collection Insulated Stainless Steel White Wine Glasses, 2 Count (Pack of 1), Soft Blue
features: MODERN ELEGANCE:  Designed in a classic white wine glass shape and insulated to keep your wine cold, they are a classy and versatile addition to your wine glass assortment

PREMIUM INSULATION:  Made of the highest quality stainless steel, they will keep wine chilled at the perfect temperature with no metal taste.  It’s just like sipping from nice glassware but without the warm wine!

COMFORTABLE TO HOLD:  The only insulated stainless steel wine glass that is smaller and lighter compared to most other wine ‘tumblers’ while still holding 8oz.  It fits beautifully in the hand and is also sweat free, so hands stay warm and dry
THIN RIMMED LIKE FINE CRYSTAL: For enjoying wine, the thinner the rim of the glass, the better.  Our 1mm rim is as thin as fine crystal but won't chip or break
MADE FOR ENTERTAINING:  Elegant and stylish enough to serve at your next dinner party but also shatterproof so you can use them indoors, on the patio or by the pool
description: Thin and lightweight, this white wine glass mimics that elegant feel of drinking from premium glassware. Made of 304 food-grade stainless steel that won’t affect the taste. The vacuum-insulated stainless steel prevents your hand from warming your sauvignon blanc and its wear-resistant coating helps to hide fingerprints. Dressed up in a fun range of colors, everyone can keep track of their own glass!
